concerns.location: tasks.md vs contracts/test_result.schema.yaml and data-model.md TestResult entity
concerns.text: No task produces TestResult rows conforming to test_result.schema.yaml (result_id, transformation_id, condition, p_value, is_significant, seed_used, iteration). T006 writes type1_error_results.csv with its own ad-hoc columns (dataset_id, transformation, test_type, error_rate, n_iterations, p_values_or_counts) and T007 writes power JSONs — neither satisfies the contract, so the TestResult entity/contract has no implementing task.

No task writes transformed data conforming to transformed_data.schema.yaml (dataset_id, variable_name, method, transformed_values, success, log_message). T004 only writes transformation records to results/transformations_log.csv per transformation.schema.yaml; the plan's data/transformed/ directory and this contract are uncovered.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T009 vs plan.md:T024 and spec FR-008
concerns.text: Plan T024 runs the Friedman test on 'per-dataset error/power outcomes'; T009 runs it only on error rates ('Friedman chi-square test ... on per-dataset error rates'). The power-side Friedman analysis has no task, leaving FR-008's inference over power outcomes partially uncovered.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T007/T008 vs spec.md US-4 acceptance scenario 3
concerns.text: US-4 scenario 3 requires power bootstrap CIs 'validated against the ±0.02 half-width target'. T007's JSON records ci_lower/ci_upper with no half-width validation, and T008's SC-004 check covers only aggregated_results.csv rows (3 transformations × 2 tests × 2 metrics), not per-combination power CIs from T007. No task validates power CIs against the target.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Requirement coverage section vs plan.md FR-mapping table
concerns.text: The coverage table maps FRs to tasks T001–T012, but plan.md's FR-mapping references plan task IDs T013–T028; no crosswalk between the two numbering schemes exists, so plan-element traceability (plan T018 diagnostic null generation, T020 applying transformations to simulated data as distinct from real data) cannot be verified. Add a plan-ID → tasks-ID mapping or note which plan tasks are intentionally consolidated/dropped (e.g. T018).
